hook: HYDRAA starts Fox Sagar revamp to lift storage *4x*
hook_b: HYDRAA starts Fox Sagar revamp to lift storage *4x*
tldr: HYDRAA launched restoration of the 1897 Fox Sagar lake in Jeedimetla on Friday, aiming to turn it into a mini reservoir and mini Tank Bund within a year.

beats.what: Works include desilting, treating polluted water, strengthening the bund, inlets and outlets, a sewage treatment plant and a ring bund, per The Hindu.
beats.why: Sewage and industrial chemical waste left nearly five metres of silt, blocking water from percolating into the ground, Commissioner A.V. Ranganath said.
beats.care: Houses built before HYDRAA was formed on July 19, 2024 will not be demolished; those losing plots in approved layouts can get TDR, per the agency.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: NEERI will test lake water and nearby groundwater before and after the works; HYDRAA will seek European experts to restore the heritage stone pump house.

cards.q: What should the Fox Sagar works fix first?

qs: How will NEERI's before-and-after tests be shared with residents?
Which industries drain into the lake today?

facts.t: Fox Sagar was built in *1897* under the Nizam and once supplied Secunderabad's drinking water.
Silt nearly *five metres* deep had stopped water from seeping into the ground, Ranganath said.

viz.verdict: More stored water for the area, if works finish as planned

learn.t: TDR = Transferable Development Rights, building rights given elsewhere in place of land lost.

watch: Whether the water-storage works finish before the next monsoon, as HYDRAA aims.

sources.name: The Hindu
sources.title: HYDRAA launches Fox Sagar Lake development; plans STP for preventing sewage, industrial effluents

fact: HYDRAA begins Fox Sagar lake revamp to raise storage *1,000 to 4,000 million litres*.
twist: Of the lake's *500 acres*, about *150 acres* had been encroached; most has been cleared, HYDRAA says.
